```{r}
scale_shadetol <- function(x) {
  
  mean_shadetol <- output_models_list$setup$`6`$shadetol_mean
  sd_shadetol <- output_models_list$setup$`6`$shadetol_sd
  
  (x - mean_shadetol) / sd_shadetol
}

scale_dbh <- function(x) {
  
  mean_dbh <- output_models_list$setup$`6`$dbh_mean
  sd_dbh <- output_models_list$setup$`6`$dbh_sd
  
  (x - mean_dbh) / sd_dbh
}

scale_compet_batot <- function(x) {
  
  mean_compet <- output_models_list$setup$`4`$compet_mean
  sd_compet <- output_models_list$setup$`4`$compet_mean
  
  (x - mean_compet) / sd_compet
}

scale_compet_bal <- function(x) {
  
  mean_compet <- output_models_list$setup$`5`$compet_mean
  sd_compet <- output_models_list$setup$`5`$compet_mean
  
  (x - mean_compet) / sd_compet
}

scale_compet_rci <- function(x) {
  
  mean_compet <- output_models_list$setup$`6`$compet_mean
  sd_compet <- output_models_list$setup$`6`$compet_mean
  
  (x - mean_compet) / sd_compet
}
```

# Models comparison

## MAE and RMSE

```{r}
if (run_model_comparison) {
  
  data_eval <- output_comparison_list$evaluation$indicators %>% 
    dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
    dplyr::left_join(exp_design_short, by = "id_model") %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(i_rep, iteration) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      MAE_control  = MAE[id_model == 1],
      RMSE_control = RMSE[id_model == 1],
      
      MAE_change  = 100 * (MAE  - MAE_control) / MAE_control,
      RMSE_change = 100 * (RMSE - RMSE_control) / RMSE_control
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(id_model, str_model) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(
      
      MAE_lower = quantile(MAE, 0.025),
      MAE_median = median(MAE),
      MAE_upper = quantile(MAE, 0.975),
      
      MAE_change_lower = quantile(MAE_change, 0.025),
      MAE_change_median = median(MAE_change),
      MAE_change_upper = quantile(MAE_change, 0.975),
      
      RMSE_lower = quantile(RMSE, 0.025),
      RMSE_median = median(RMSE),
      RMSE_upper = quantile(RMSE, 0.975),
      
      RMSE_change_lower = quantile(RMSE_change, 0.025),
      RMSE_change_median = median(RMSE_change),
      RMSE_change_upper = quantile(RMSE_change, 0.975)
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(id_model)
  
  data_eval
}
```

# Main results

## LAD model definition

```{r}
predict_lad <- function(trees_df, 
                        params_df,
                        mean_site = TRUE, 
                        mean_sp = TRUE,
                        predict_la = FALSE) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Identify the fixed effects available in the parameter table
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  coefficient_pattern <- paste0(
    "^p_(intercept|shadetol|dbh|compet|",
    "shadetolXdbh|shadetolXcompet|dbhXcompet|",
    "shadetolXdbhXcompet)\\."
  )

  fixed_params <- params_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      id_set,
      dplyr::contains("sigma"),
      dplyr::matches(coefficient_pattern)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::matches(coefficient_pattern),
      names_to = c(".value", "leaf_group"),
      names_sep = "\\."
    )

  # Map each possible coefficient to its corresponding predictor.
  # Only terms with coefficients in params_df will be used.
  term_map <- list(
    p_shadetol = function(x) x$shadetol_scaled,
    p_dbh = function(x) x$dbh_scaled,
    p_compet = function(x) x$compet_scaled,

    p_shadetolXdbh = function(x) {
      x$shadetol_scaled * x$dbh_scaled
    },

    p_shadetolXcompet = function(x) {
      x$shadetol_scaled * x$compet_scaled
    },

    p_dbhXcompet = function(x) {
      x$dbh_scaled * x$compet_scaled
    },

    p_shadetolXdbhXcompet = function(x) {
      x$shadetol_scaled * x$dbh_scaled * x$compet_scaled
    }
  )

  available_terms <- intersect(names(term_map), names(fixed_params))

  if (!"p_intercept" %in% names(fixed_params) &&
      length(available_terms) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No supported fixed-effect coefficients were found in params_df."
    )
  }

  # Describe the model being run.
  model_terms <- c(
    if ("p_intercept" %in% names(fixed_params)) "intercept",
    sub("^p_", "", available_terms)
  )

  message(
    "Running LAD model: ",
    paste(model_terms, collapse = " + "),
    ". Random effects: species = ",
    if (mean_sp) "population-level" else "species-specific",
    "; site/origin = ",
    if (mean_site) "population-level" else "site/origin-specific",
    "."
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Prepare random effects, if available
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  site_effects <- params_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      id_set,
      dplyr::starts_with("p_z_site.")
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -id_set,
      names_to = "site",
      values_to = "z_site",
      names_prefix = "p_z_site."
    )

  origin_effects <- params_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      id_set,
      dplyr::starts_with("p_z_origin.")
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -id_set,
      names_to = "origin",
      values_to = "z_origin",
      names_prefix = "p_z_origin."
    )

  sp_effects <- params_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      id_set,
      dplyr::starts_with("p_z_sp.")
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -id_set,
      names_to = "species",
      values_to = "z_sp",
      names_prefix = "p_z_sp."
    )

  # Start with all combinations of trees and parameter sets.
  out <- tidyr::crossing(
    trees_df,
    id_set = unique(params_df$id_set)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      fixed_params,
      by = c("id_set", "leaf_group")
    )

  # Join random effects only when requested and identifiable
  # from the available parameters and tree data.
  if (!mean_site) {
    if ("site" %in% names(out) &&
        "origin" %in% names(out) &&
        "z_site" %in% names(site_effects) &&
        "z_origin" %in% names(origin_effects)) {

      out <- out %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          site_effects, by = c("id_set", "site")
        ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          origin_effects, by = c("id_set", "origin")
        )

    } else {
      message(
        "Site/origin effects unavailable or identifiers missing; ",
        "using zero site/origin effects."
      )
    }
  }

  if (!mean_sp) {
    if ("species" %in% names(out) &&
        "z_sp" %in% names(sp_effects)) {

      out <- out %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          sp_effects, by = c("id_set", "species")
        )

    } else {
      message(
        "Species effects unavailable or species identifier missing; ",
        "using zero species effects."
      )
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Calculate only the scaled predictors needed by the model
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (any(grepl("shadetol", available_terms))) {
    if (!"shadetol" %in% names(out)) {
      stop("The model requires shadetol, but trees_df has no shadetol column.")
    }
    out$shadetol_scaled <- scale_shadetol(out$shadetol)
  }

  if (any(grepl("dbh", available_terms))) {
    if (!"dbh_cm" %in% names(out)) {
      stop("The model requires dbh_cm, but trees_df has no dbh_cm column.")
    }
    out$dbh_scaled <- scale_dbh(out$dbh_cm)
  }

  if (any(grepl("compet", available_terms))) {
    if (!"rci" %in% names(out)) {
      stop("The model requires rci, but trees_df has no rci column.")
    }
    out$compet_scaled <- scale_compet_rci(out$rci)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Calculate the linear predictor and transform to LAD
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  eta <- rep(0, nrow(out))

  if ("p_intercept" %in% names(out)) {
    eta <- eta + dplyr::coalesce(out$p_intercept, 0)
  }

  for (term in available_terms) {
    eta <- eta +
      dplyr::coalesce(out[[term]], 0) * term_map[[term]](out)
  }

  # Species random intercept
  sp_effect <- rep(0, nrow(out))

  if (!mean_sp &&
      "z_sp" %in% names(out) &&
      "p_sigma_sp_log" %in% names(out)) {

    sp_effect <- out$z_sp * exp(out$p_sigma_sp_log)
    sp_effect[is.na(sp_effect)] <- 0
  }

  # Site and origin random intercepts
  site_effect <- rep(0, nrow(out))

  if (!mean_site) {

    if ("z_origin" %in% names(out) &&
        "p_sigma_origin_log" %in% names(out)) {

      origin_component <- out$z_origin *
        exp(out$p_sigma_origin_log)

      origin_component[is.na(origin_component)] <- 0
      site_effect <- site_effect + origin_component
    }

    if ("z_site" %in% names(out) &&
        "p_sigma_site_log" %in% names(out)) {

      site_component <- out$z_site *
        exp(out$p_sigma_site_log)

      site_component[is.na(site_component)] <- 0
      site_effect <- site_effect + site_component
    }
  }

  out <- out %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      lad = exp(eta + sp_effect + site_effect),
      la = if (predict_la) lad * volume_m3 else NA_real_
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Summarise predictions across parameter sets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  out %>%
    dplyr::group_by(id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      lad_lower = quantile(lad, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      lad_median = median(lad, na.rm = TRUE),
      lad_upper = quantile(lad, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

      la_lower = if (all(is.na(la))) NA_real_ else
        quantile(la, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),

      la_median = if (all(is.na(la))) NA_real_ else
        median(la, na.rm = TRUE),

      la_upper = if (all(is.na(la))) NA_real_ else
        quantile(la, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
```


## Get DBH values for each group

```{r}
mod_qr_dbhVSrci <- rq(
  dbh_cm ~ rci*shadetol*leaf_group,
  tau = c(0.05, 0.95),
  data = data_inventory
)

vals_dbh_from_rci <- expand.grid(
  compet = names(vals_compet),
  leaf_group = c("needle", "broad"),
  shadetol_group = c("shade intolerant", "shade tolerant")
) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rci = vals_compet[compet],
    shadetol = vals_shadetol[shadetol_group]
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(dbh_small = predict(mod_qr_dbhVSrci, newdata = .)[,1],
                dbh_large = predict(mod_qr_dbhVSrci, newdata = .)[,2])

ggplot(vals_dbh_from_rci, aes(y = compet, color = shadetol_group)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = dbh_small, xmax = dbh_large), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                 linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = dbh_small), shape = 1, 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(x = dbh_large), shape = 2, 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~leaf_group) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```


## ---- Figure 1: LAD prediction by leaf group x shade tolerance group

```{r}
# 1. Predict LAD from the full model
pred_grid_lad <- expand.grid(
  compet = names(vals_compet),
  leaf_group = c("needle", "broad"),
  shadetol_group = c("shade tolerant", "shade intolerant"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(
    vals_dbh_from_rci,
    by = c("compet", "leaf_group", "shadetol_group")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    dbh_cm = list(seq(dbh_small, dbh_large, length.out = 100))
  ) %>%
  unnest(dbh_cm) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    shadetol = unname(vals_shadetol[shadetol_group]),
    compet = factor(compet, levels = names(vals_compet)),
    lad_assumption = "tree-level"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    predict_lad(
      trees_df = .,
      params_df = output_analysis_list$output_params[[id_mod_full]],
      mean_site = TRUE,
      mean_sp = TRUE
    ),
    by = "id"
  )


# 2. Predict the constant-LAD model
#    No DBH or competition effect is assumed
pred_grid_const <- expand.grid(
  leaf_group = c("needle", "broad"),
  shadetol_group = c("shade tolerant", "shade intolerant"),
  dbh_cm = seq(0, max_plot_dbh, length.out = 100),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    shadetol = unname(vals_shadetol[shadetol_group])
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    predict_lad(
      trees_df = .,
      params_df = output_analysis_list$output_params[[id_mod_const]],
      mean_site = TRUE,
      mean_sp = TRUE
    ),
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lad_assumption = "species-specific",
    leaf_group = factor(leaf_group, levels = c("needle", "broad")),
    shadetol_group = factor(
      shadetol_group,
      levels = c("shade intolerant", "shade tolerant")
    )
  )


# 3. Plot function
plot_leaf <- function(leaf) {

  # Keep the given leaf
  full_data <- pred_grid_lad %>%
    filter(leaf_group == leaf)

  const_data <- pred_grid_const %>%
    filter(leaf_group == leaf)

  # Set the maximum y to be similar between leaf group
  y_max <- max(
    pred_grid_lad$lad_upper,
    pred_grid_const$lad_upper,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  
  y_limits <- c(0, y_max)
  
  # Plot the graph
  ggplot(
    full_data,
    aes(
      x = dbh_cm,
      y = lad_median,
      colour = compet,
      linetype = lad_assumption
    )
  ) +

    # Constant-model uncertainty: 
    geom_ribbon(
      data = const_data,
      aes(
        x = dbh_cm,
        ymin = lad_lower,
        ymax = lad_upper,
        group = shadetol_group
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 0.18,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Constant-model estimate
    geom_line(
      data = const_data,
      aes(
        x = dbh_cm,
        y = lad_median,
        group = shadetol_group,
        linetype = lad_assumption
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "grey45",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    
    # Full-model uncertainty
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = lad_lower,
        ymax = lad_upper,
        fill = compet,
        group = compet
      ),
      alpha = 0.12,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Full-model predictions
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~shadetol_group,
      nrow = 1,
      labeller = labeller(
        shadetol_group = c(
          "shade intolerant" = "Shade intolerant",
          "shade tolerant" = "Shade tolerant"
        )
      )
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = cols_compet,
      labels = labels_compet,
      name = "Competition"
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = cols_compet,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "species-specific" = "22",
        "tree-level" = "solid"
      ),
      name = "LAD assumption"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = if (leaf == "needle") "Needle-leaved" else "Broad-leaved",
      x = "Tree DBH (cm)",
      y = expression("Predicted LAD (" * m^2 ~ m^{-3} * ")")
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, max_plot_dbh),
      ylim = y_limits
    ) +

    theme_lad
}


# 4. Build panels
p_needle <- plot_leaf("needle")
p_broad  <- plot_leaf("broad") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())


# 5. Extract shared legend
legend <- cowplot::get_legend(

      ),
      linetype = guide_legend(

        order = 1,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        override.aes = list(

        )
      )
    )
)

# 6. Combine panels and legend

  cowplot::plot_grid(
```

## Estimate LAD and LA on observed crown volumes

```{r}
data_crown <- data_stands %>% 
  purrr::map(~.x$trees %>% dplyr::filter(!added_to_fill, volume_measured)) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows(.id = "site") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(id = row_number()) %>% 
  
  dplyr::left_join(
    predict_lad(., output_analysis_list$output_params[[id_mod_full]],
                mean_site = TRUE, mean_sp = TRUE,
                predict_la = TRUE),
    by = "id"
  )%>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    predict_lad(., output_analysis_list$output_params[[id_mod_const]],
                mean_site = TRUE, mean_sp = TRUE,
                predict_la = TRUE) %>%
      rename(
        lad_const_lower = lad_lower,
        lad_const_median = lad_median,
        lad_const_upper = lad_upper,
        
        la_const_lower = la_lower,
        la_const_median = la_median,
        la_const_upper = la_upper
      ),
    by = "id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Assign each tree to its nearest representative shade-tolerance value
    shadetol_group = names(vals_shadetol)[
      vapply(
        shadetol,
        function(x) which.min(abs(vals_shadetol - x)),
        integer(1)
      )
    ],
    
    # Competition categories are only for display.
    # Models below use continuous rci.
    compet = names(vals_compet)[
      vapply(
        rci,
        function(x) which.min(abs(vals_compet - x)),
        integer(1)
      )
    ],
    
    leaf_group = factor(leaf_group, levels = c("needle", "broad")),
    shadetol_group = factor(
      shadetol_group,
      levels = names(vals_shadetol)
    ),
    compet = factor(compet, levels = names(vals_compet))
  )
```


## Get volume values for each group

```{r}
mod_qr_volumeVSrci <- rq(
  volume_m3 ~ rci*shadetol*leaf_group,
  tau = c(0.05, 0.95),
  data = data_crown
)

vals_volume_from_rci <- expand.grid(
  compet = names(vals_compet),
  leaf_group = c("needle", "broad"),
  shadetol_group = c("shade intolerant", "shade tolerant")
) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    rci = vals_compet[compet],
    shadetol = vals_shadetol[shadetol_group]
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(volume_small = predict(mod_qr_volumeVSrci, newdata = .)[,1],
                volume_large = predict(mod_qr_volumeVSrci, newdata = .)[,2])

ggplot(vals_volume_from_rci, aes(y = compet, color = shadetol_group)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = volume_small, xmax = volume_large), 
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                 linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = volume_small), shape = 1, 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(x = volume_large), shape = 2, 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
             size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~leaf_group) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```

## ---- Figure 2: Relationships between LA and crown volume

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Fit the tree-level LAD-implied leaf-area model
# ============================================================

mod_la <- lmer(
  log(la_median) ~
    log(volume_m3) * log(shadetol) * log(rci) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  data = data_crown
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Build the tree-level prediction grid
#    Each curve has its own observed volume range
# ============================================================

pred_grid_full <- vals_volume_from_rci %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    volume_m3 = list(
      exp(seq(log(volume_small), log(volume_large), length.out = 150))
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(volume_m3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    shadetol = unname(vals_shadetol[shadetol_group]),
    rci = unname(vals_compet[as.character(compet)]),

    shadetol_group = factor(
      shadetol_group,
      levels = c("shade intolerant", "shade tolerant")
    ),

    id = row_number(),

    # Placeholder grouping variables; population-level predictions
    # exclude random effects.
    species = data_crown$species[1],
    origin = data_crown$origin[1],
    site = data_crown$site[1]
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. Predict log leaf area and its fixed-effect uncertainty
# ============================================================

get_la_curve <- function(model, newdata) {

  # Population-level prediction on the log scale
  fit_log <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = newdata,
    re.form = NA,
    allow.new.levels = TRUE
  )

  # Design matrix for fixed effects only
  fixed_terms <- stats::delete.response(
    stats::terms(lme4::nobars(formula(model)))
  )

  X <- model.matrix(fixed_terms, data = newdata)
  V <- as.matrix(vcov(model))

  # Standard error of the estimated fixed-effect mean
  se_log <- sqrt(
    pmax(0, rowSums((X %*% V) * X))
  )

  newdata %>%
    mutate(
      fit_log = as.numeric(fit_log),
      se_log = se_log,

      # Back-transformed fitted central relationship
      fit = exp(fit_log),

      # 95% confidence interval for the estimated mean curve
      lower = exp(fit_log - 1.96 * se_log),
      upper = exp(fit_log + 1.96 * se_log),

      lad_assumption = "tree-level"
    )
}

curves_full <- get_la_curve(
  mod_la,
  pred_grid_full
)


# ============================================================
# 4. Build the constant-LAD reference relationship
# ============================================================

# Reuse pred_grid_const from your LAD-vs-DBH script.
# Its LAD predictions should be constant across DBH within
# each leaf type and shade-tolerance group.

const_lad <- pred_grid_const %>%
  group_by(leaf_group, shadetol_group) %>%
  summarise(
    lad_const = median(lad_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    lad_lower = median(lad_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    lad_upper = median(lad_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


pred_grid_const_la <- vals_volume_from_rci %>%
  dplyr::group_by(shadetol_group, leaf_group) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(
    volume_small = min(volume_small),
    volume_large = max(volume_large)
  ) %>% 
  left_join(
    const_lad,
    by = c("leaf_group", "shadetol_group")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    volume_m3 = list(
      exp(seq(log(volume_small), log(volume_large), length.out = 150))
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(volume_m3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Direct consequence of the constant-LAD assumption:
    # LA = constant LAD * crown volume
    fit = lad_const * volume_m3,
    lower = lad_lower * volume_m3,
    upper = lad_upper * volume_m3,
    lad_assumption = "species-specific",

    shadetol_group = factor(
      shadetol_group,
      levels = c("shade intolerant", "shade tolerant")
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. Plot function
# ============================================================

make_la_plot <- function(leaf) {

  full_data <- curves_full %>%
    filter(leaf_group == leaf)

  const_data <- pred_grid_const_la %>%
    filter(leaf_group == leaf)

  points_data <- data_crown %>%
    filter(leaf_group == leaf, volume_m3 > 0)

  ggplot() +

    # Constant-LAD reference uncertainty
    geom_ribbon(
      data = const_data,
      aes(
        x = volume_m3,
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        group = shadetol_group
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 0.18,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Tree-level model uncertainty
    geom_ribbon(
      data = full_data,
      aes(
        x = volume_m3,
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        fill = compet,
        group = interaction(compet, shadetol_group)
      ),
      alpha = 0.12,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Individual tree estimates derived from the tree-level LAD
    geom_point(
      data = points_data,
      aes(
        x = volume_m3,
        y = la_median,
        colour = compet
      ),
      alpha = 0.05,
      size = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +

    # Constant-LAD reference: one grey dotted curve per facet,
    # independent of competition
    geom_line(
      data = const_data,
      aes(
        x = volume_m3,
        y = fit,
        linetype = lad_assumption,
        group = shadetol_group
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "grey45",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    # Tree-level LAD model: competition-specific solid curves
    geom_line(
      data = full_data,
      aes(
        x = volume_m3,
        y = fit,
        colour = compet,
        linetype = lad_assumption,
        group = interaction(compet, shadetol_group)
      ),
      linewidth = 1
    ) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~shadetol_group,
      nrow = 1,
      labeller = labeller(
        shadetol_group = c(
          "shade intolerant" = "Shade intolerant",
          "shade tolerant" = "Shade tolerant"
        )
      )
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = cols_compet,
      labels = labels_compet,
      name = "Tree social status"
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = cols_compet,
      guide = "none"
    ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "species-specific" = "22",
        "tree-level" = "solid"
      ),
      breaks = c("species-specific", "tree-level"),
      labels = c("Species-specific", "Tree-level"),
      name = "LAD model"
    ) +

    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
      labels = as.character(c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000))
    ) +

    scale_y_log10(
      breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000),
      labels = as.character(c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000))
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(1, NA),
      ylim = c(1, NA)
    ) +

    labs(
      title = if (leaf == "needle") {
        "Needle-leaved"
      } else {
        "Broad-leaved"
      },
      x = expression("Observed crown volume (" * m^3 * ")"),
      y = expression("Model-derived leaf area (" * m^2 * ")")
    ) +

    theme_lad +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "pt")
    )
}


# ============================================================
# 7. Build panels
# ============================================================

p_needle <- make_la_plot("needle")

p_broad <- make_la_plot("broad") +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())


# ============================================================
# 8. Extract shared legend
# ============================================================

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_la_plot("needle") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt")
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(
        title = "Tree social status",
        nrow = 1,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        order = 2,
        override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.3, alpha = 1)
      ),
      linetype = guide_legend(
        title = "LAD model",
        order = 1,
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        override.aes = list(
          colour = "grey35",
          linewidth = 1
        )
      )
    )
)

p_needle <- p_needle + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_broad  <- p_broad  + theme(legend.position = "none")


# ============================================================
# 9. Combine panels and legend
# ============================================================

cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend,
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_needle,
    p_broad,
    nrow = 1,
    align = "hv"
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.35, 1)
)
```

## Appendix: Effect of LAD model on tree leaf area

```{r}
#############################################################
# Full LAD model: predicted leaf area using la_median
#############################################################

m_la_full <- glmmTMB(
  log(la_median) ~
    log(dbh_cm) * log(rci) * log(shadetol) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  dispformula = ~ log(dbh_cm),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data_crown
)

#############################################################
# Fixed LAD model: predicted leaf area using la_const_median
#############################################################

m_la_const <- glmmTMB(
  log(la_const_median) ~
    log(dbh_cm) * log(rci) * log(shadetol) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  dispformula = ~ log(dbh_cm),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data_crown
)

#############################################################
# Prediction grid
#############################################################

pred_grid_la <- expand.grid(
  compet = names(vals_compet),
  leaf_group = c("needle", "broad"),
  shadetol_group = names(vals_shadetol)
) %>%
  left_join(
    vals_dbh_from_rci,
    by = c("compet", "leaf_group", "shadetol_group")
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    dbh_cm = list(seq(
      from = dbh_small,
      to = dbh_large,
      length.out = 100
    ))
  ) %>%
  unnest(dbh_cm) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    shadetol = unname(vals_shadetol[shadetol_group]),
    rci = unname(vals_compet[compet]),
    compet = factor(compet, levels = names(vals_compet))
  )

#############################################################
# Predictions on the original leaf-area scale
#############################################################

predict_la <- function(model, newdata) {

  eta <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = newdata,
    type = "link",
    re.form = NA
  )

  # Dispersion parameter for the log-scale Gaussian model
  disp <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = newdata,
    type = "disp",
    re.form = NA
  )

  # Back-transform to the expected leaf area
  exp(eta + disp / 2)
}

pred_grid_la <- pred_grid_la %>%
  mutate(
    la_full = predict_la(m_la_full, .),
    la_const = predict_la(m_la_const, .)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(la_full, la_const),
    names_to = "lad_assumption",
    values_to = "la_pred"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lad_assumption = factor(
      lad_assumption,
      levels = c("la_full", "la_const"),
      labels = c("tree-level", "species-specific")
    )
  )

#############################################################
# Function to build one leaf-group panel
#############################################################

plot_leaf_la <- function(leaf) {

  ggplot(
    pred_grid_la %>% filter(leaf_group == leaf),
    aes(
      x = dbh_cm,
      y = la_pred,
      colour = compet,
      linetype = lad_assumption,
      group = interaction(compet, lad_assumption)
    )
  ) +

    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

    facet_wrap(
      ~ shadetol_group,
      nrow = 1,
      labeller = labeller(
        shadetol_group = c(
          "shade intolerant" = "Shade intolerant",
          "shade tolerant" = "Shade tolerant"
        )
      )
    ) +

    scale_colour_manual(
      values = cols_compet,
      labels = c(
        dominant =
          paste0("Dominant (RCI = ", vals_compet["dominant"], ")"),
        `co-dominant` =
          paste0("Co-dominant (RCI = ", vals_compet["co-dominant"], ")"),
        suppressed =
          paste0("Suppressed (RCI = ", vals_compet["suppressed"], ")")
      ),
      name = "Competition"
    ) +

    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "tree-level" = "solid",
        "species-specific" = "dotted"
      ),
      name = "LAD approach"
    ) +

    labs(
      title = ifelse(
        leaf == "needle",
        "Needle-leaved",
        "Broad-leaved"
      ),
      x = "Tree DBH (cm)",
      y = expression("Predicted leaf area (" * m^2 * ")")
    ) +

    theme_lad +
    
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(0, max_plot_dbh)
    )
}

#############################################################
# Build plots
#############################################################

p_needle <- plot_leaf_la("needle") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_broad <- plot_leaf_la("broad") +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

#############################################################
# Combine
#############################################################

cowplot::plot_grid(
  legend,
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_needle,
    p_broad,
    nrow = 1,
    align = "hv"
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.35, 1)
)
```







## Appendix: Models of observed crown volume

```{r}
m0 <- glmmTMB(
  log(volume_m3) ~
    log(dbh_cm) * log(shadetol) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  dispformula = ~ log(dbh_cm),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data_crown
)

m_rci <- glmmTMB(
  log(volume_m3) ~
    log(dbh_cm) * log(rci) * log(shadetol) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  dispformula = ~ log(dbh_cm),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data_crown
)

m_batot <- glmmTMB(
  log(volume_m3) ~
    log(dbh_cm) * log(batot_local_m2ha) * log(shadetol) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  dispformula = ~ log(dbh_cm),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data_crown
)

m_bal <- glmmTMB(
  log(volume_m3) ~
    log(dbh_cm) * log(bal_local_m2ha + 0.001) * log(shadetol) * leaf_group +
    (1 | species) +
    (1 | origin/site),
  dispformula = ~ log(dbh_cm),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data_crown
)

model_comp <- BIC(m0, m_rci, m_batot, m_bal) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    delta_BIC = BIC - min(BIC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(BIC)

model_comp
```

```{r}
mod_volume <- m_rci

pred_grid_volume <- expand.grid(
  compet = names(vals_compet),
  leaf_group = c("needle", "broad"),
  shadetol_group = names(vals_shadetol)
) %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(vals_dbh_from_rci, by = c("compet", "leaf_group", "shadetol_group")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    dbh_cm = list(seq(
      from = dbh_small,
      to = dbh_large,
      length.out = 100
    ))
  ) %>%
  unnest(dbh_cm) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    id_tree = row_number(),
    shadetol = vals_shadetol[shadetol_group],
    compet = factor(compet, levels = names(vals_compet))) %>% 
  
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    volume_pred = exp(
      predict(
        mod_volume,
        newdata = .,
        type = "link",
        re.form = NA
      ) +
        predict(
          mod_volume,
          newdata = .,
          type = "disp",
          re.form = NA
        ) / 2
    )
  )

#############################################################
# Function to build one leaf-group panel

plot_leaf <- function(leaf){

  ggplot(
```

```{r}
cells_core <- purrr::imap(
  data_stands,
  function(stand, stand_name){

    #----------------------------------------
    # Convert cell centres to 5x5 m polygons
    #----------------------------------------
    cell_poly <- stand$cells %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        geometry = list(
          st_polygon(list(matrix(
            c(
              x_center - 2.5, y_center - 2.5,
              x_center + 2.5, y_center - 2.5,
              x_center + 2.5, y_center + 2.5,
              x_center - 2.5, y_center + 2.5,
              x_center - 2.5, y_center - 2.5
            ),
            ncol = 2,
            byrow = TRUE
          )))
        )
      ) %>%
      st_as_sf()

    #----------------------------------------
    # Keep cells intersecting the core polygon
    #----------------------------------------
    cell_poly$inside <- lengths(
      st_intersects(
        cell_poly,
        stand$core_polygon$sf
      )
    ) > 0

    cell_poly %>%
      filter(inside) %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      mutate(site = stand_name) %>%
      select(site, id_cell)

  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()


site_names <- data_inventory %>% 
  dplyr::select(site, origin) %>% 
  dplyr::distinct() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    
    origin_new = origin,
    site_new = site,
    
    origin = case_match(origin,
      "irres2018" ~ "IRRES",
      "cloture" ~ "Cloture",
      "baileux" ~ "Baileux",
      "ventoux" ~ "Ventoux",
      "fontfreyde" ~ "Fontfreyde",
      "lorris" ~ "Lorris"
    ),
    site = gsub("irres2018_", "IRRES", site),
    site = gsub("cloture_", "Cloture", site),
    site = gsub("ventoux_", "Ventoux", site),
    site = gsub("fontfreyde_", "Fontfreyde", site),
    site = gsub("lorris_", "Lorris", site),
    site = case_when(
      site == "baileux_beech" ~ "BaileuxBeech",
      site == "baileux_mixed" ~ "BaileuxMixed",
      site == "baileux_oak" ~ "BaileuxOak",
      site == "Cloture14" ~ "Cloture13",
      TRUE ~ site
    )
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::drop_na()


out_energy_cells <- rbindlist(lapply(output_analysis_list$output_tree_light, function(x) {
  cbind(
    site = x$site_name,
    id_mod = x$id_mod,
    x$out_cells %>% dplyr::select(-e)
  )
}), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE) %>%
  
  dplyr::left_join(site_names, by = "site") %>% 
  dplyr::right_join(cells_core, by = c("site_new" = "site", "id_cell")) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>% 
  dplyr::select(origin, site, id_set, id_cell, id_mod, pacl) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = id_mod,
    values_from = pacl,
    names_prefix = "Model_"
  )


############################################################
# Regression PACL_constant vs PACL_full
############################################################

mod_pacl <- lmer(Model_6 ~ Model_2 + (1 | origin/site), 
                 data = out_energy_cells)
  
pacl_pred <- data.frame(
  Model_2 = seq(
    min(out_energy_cells$Model_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(out_energy_cells$Model_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  )
)

# Fixed-effects predictions and standard errors
X <- model.matrix(~ Model_2, data = pacl_pred)
beta <- fixef(mod_pacl)
V <- vcov(mod_pacl)

pacl_pred <- pacl_pred %>%
  mutate(
    Model_6 = as.vector(X %*% beta),
    se = sqrt(diag(X %*% V %*% t(X))),
    lower = Model_6 - 1.96 * se,
    upper = Model_6 + 1.96 * se
  )

############################################################
# Mean PACL per cell, pooling across origins
############################################################

cell_means <- out_energy_cells %>%
  group_by(site, id_cell) %>%
  summarise(
    Model_2 = mean(Model_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Model_6 = mean(Model_6, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
# Plot
############################################################

p_pacl <- ggplot() +

  # Background: mean PACL for each cell
  geom_point(
    data = cell_means,
    aes(x = Model_2, y = Model_6),
    colour = "grey65",
    alpha = 0.1,
    size = 1
  ) +

  # Reference: equal PACL
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    colour = "grey25",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "22"
  ) +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pacl_pred,
    aes(x = Model_2, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    fill = "#E89951",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +

  # Single pooled regression line
  geom_line(
    data = pacl_pred,
    aes(x = Model_2, y = Model_6),
    colour = "#CC6633",
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +

  coord_equal() +

  labs(
    y = expression(
      "Predicted PACL considering tree-level variation in LAD"
    ),
    x = expression(
      "Predicted PACL using a constant LAD"
    )
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_pacl
```
